module: Reading and caching of vehicles' .jbeam files. For each requested folder, parses each *.jbeam (JSON), normalizes the slots/slots2 sections to the slots2 format (name, allowTypes, denyTypes, default, description), stores each encoded part in a cache and builds indexes (part -> file, slotType -> parts, part -> description). It then allows retrieving a part (getPart), listing the available parts and those compatible with a slot. A modder uses it to query a vehicle's parts/slots from a GE extension.
usage:
local io = require('jbeam/io')
local ioCtx = io.startLoading({'/vehicles/pickup/', '/vehicles/common/'})
local mainName = io.getMainPartName(ioCtx)
local part, filename = io.getPart(ioCtx, mainName)
notes: ioCtx is the context returned by startLoading: {preloadedDirs = list of folders}. Folders have the form '/vehicles/<name>/' (with trailing slash, without leading slash in the internal pattern).

The cache is global to the module: each file is parsed only once. onFileChanged invalidates it for a modified .jbeam and forces a new scan of the folders at the next startLoading; the indexes stay stale until that reload (intended according to the comment).
Parts are stored encoded (stringBufferEncode): getPart returns a fresh decoded copy on each call, which can be modified without affecting the cache.
A part without slotType (string or table) is ignored with a log error. A part with the same name present twice in the same slotType triggers the error 'Duplicate part found'.
The slots (v1) format is converted to slots2 (name = type, allowTypes = {type}, denyTypes = {}); the missing header array is added with a warning. On output, part.slots is nil and part.slots2 exists.
getAvailableSlotNameMap is marked DEPRECATED in the code (incompatible with slots2); use getCompatiblePartNamesForSlot.
The local function updateAllVehiclesCompatibleParts is not exported.
The file is marked "do not change this file without speaking to tdev" in the code.
The modules core_modmanager (onExtensionLoaded) and FS are only available on the GE side.

startLoading.desc: Parses (or fetches from cache) all the *.jbeam of the given folders, rebuilds the global indexes if a file changed and records statistics (total/cachedHits).

finishLoading.desc: Does nothing (the body is commented out); exists for symmetry with startLoading.

getPart.desc: Returns the full definition of a part (decoded jbeam table, with partName) and the source file.

returns.desc: Decoded part; nil if not found or name is nil.

getMainPartName.desc: Name of the first part declared with the slotType 'main' in the context's folders.

getAvailableParts.desc: Lists all the parts of the context's folders with their description (description, authors, isAuxiliary, slotInfoUi, modName if any). Reloads if the indexes are missing; logs an error in case of duplicate names.

returns.desc: Table partName -> description; nil if the context is invalid.

getAvailableSlotNameMap.desc: Obsolete. Returns for each slotType the list of parts that fit it (according to the part's slotType).

returns.desc: slotType -> part names; nil if invalid context.

getAvailablePartNamesForSlot.desc: Lists the part names whose slotType is slotType (does not handle slots2).

getCompatiblePartNamesForSlot.desc: Parts compatible with a slot. For a v1 slot (field type) returns the parts of that type. For a v2 slot, keeps the parts with a slotType in allowTypes and none of whose types is in denyTypes; the others are returned with the reason 'Part type is in deny list'.

slotDef.desc: Slot definition (element of part.slots2 or part.slots).

slotMap.desc: Result of getAvailableSlotNameMap, to provide if calling several times (optimization).

getLastStartLoadingStats.desc: Statistics of the last startLoading: total number of files and number served by the cache.

onFileChanged.desc: Hook called when a file changes on disk: for a .jbeam, deletes its cache and forces a new scan of the folders.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: gets extensions.core_modmanager to associate parts with their mod.
